text:
Daniel: Hi all — quick onboarding questions. 1) I signed up for FSA but it still shows pending. 2) I start Dec 27, will I get the company holiday on Jan 1 (how is that prorated)? 3) where do I submit a receipt for a pre-start laptop purchase for reimbursement?

Maya: Welcome! :wave: FSA pending usually means HR is verifying your enrollment or waiting for the carrier sync (can take 2 business days). Holidays: we prorate holiday pay for first partial months based on calendar days in the pay period. If you want a concrete number tell me your salary band. Laptop: reimbursements go through Expensify, category "Equipment" and tag manager for approval.

BenefitsBot: FSA enrollment received 2025-12-20. Carrier sync ETA: 48-72 hours.

Daniel: I'm in band IC2 (salaried). Also I used a personal card for the laptop.

Maya: For IC2 salaried folks we calculate holiday proration as (eligible days worked / total workdays in pay period) * holiday pay. Jan 1 falls inside the first pay period for Dec 27 starts, so you'd get a prorated amount. Send salary and I can run numbers. For the laptop, upload invoice + proof of payment to Expensify -> New Expense -> Equipment -> attach receipts and select ACH. Mark "new hire equipment" in notes so finance routes correctly.

Payroll: Payroll cutoff reminder: Friday 17:00 PT. Reimbursements approved before cutoff are included in the next pay run. Expedited requests: email people-ops@redwood.inference with justification and we can flag for priority.

Daniel: Thanks — sending salary band now. Also if FSA is pending past 72 hours who do I chase?

Maya: If pending >72 hours DM me and we'll escalate to benefits@redwood.inference. Also check the benefits portal for any missing dependent docs or photo ID prompts.

Daniel: Great, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
